rlsNoPolicy.rule: A server/service-role-only table with RLS enabled and no policy is DENY_ALL_INTENTIONAL: RLS with zero policies denies anon/authenticated by default and SECURITY DEFINER functions (owner = postgres, bypasses RLS) plus service_role keep access. Document it; do NOT add policies just to silence the advisor.
rlsNoPolicy.clientDirectAccess: No src/ file references any of the 16 tables through supabase.from(...) (grep of src, 2026-10-08). The learner client never reads or writes them directly.
rlsNoPolicy.leastPrivilegeFollowUp: anon/authenticated still hold table-level grants on most public tables (least_privilege_api_grants not applied; production-snapshot rlsBehavior.tablePrivileges). RLS-without-policy is the only barrier today; the grant revoke is tracked in the migration plan (20260828020000_least_privilege_api_grants.sql, UNSAFE_UNTIL_RECONCILED) and is not part of silencing this advisor.

functionSearchPathMutable.verified: Live read 2026-10-08: all 14 functions are SECURITY INVOKER (prosecdef = false) with proconfig = NULL (no search_path pinned). None is SECURITY DEFINER and none reads or writes a table in its production definition.
functionSearchPathMutable.risk: LOW. A mutable search_path only matters when a function runs with elevated privilege or resolves user-writable objects. Every body calls pg_catalog functions/operators only (md5, now, timezone, to_char, left, trim, random, floor, jsonb_*), which always resolve from pg_catalog first. They are invoked from SECURITY DEFINER callers that pin their own search_path.
functionSearchPathMutable.proposedFix: ALTER FUNCTION public.<name>(<args>) SET search_path = '' (metadata-only, additive, reversible with RESET search_path). Safe for all 14 because bodies only use pg_catalog objects (economy_row_to_json takes the public.user_economy row type, which is resolved at definition time, not by search_path). Apply as ONE forward migration together with the rest of the reconciled set after backup + owner approval; not applied here. Verify locally against a restored schema dump first.
functionSearchPathMutable.doNotDo: Do not re-run 006_economy_server.sql / 004_leagues.sql / 013_pedagogy_rpc_hardening.sql / 017_referrals.sql to 'fix' this: they are SUPERSEDED/UNSAFE_UNTIL_RECONCILED in docs/launch/rc2-3-10b-migration-plan.json and would overwrite newer production objects.

anonSecurityDefiner.rule: PUBLIC_INTENTIONAL only if rate-limited AND session-token gated (anon callers cannot reach the insert without a server-issued token).

functions.name: submit_beta_feedback
functions.signature: (p_category, p_message, p_anon_session_token, p_route, p_lesson_id, p_exercise_kind, p_exercise_index, p_app_version, p_browser, p_viewport, p_local_profile_id, p_client_dedupe_key)
gates: Anonymous callers must pass p_anon_session_token; with no auth.uid() and no token it raises anon_session_required.

Token resolved by beta_anon_resolve_ingestion_session (hashed token, issued only by the issue-anon-ingestion-session Edge Function, which derives an HMAC rate-bucket key and returns 429 rate_limited on over-issuance).
beta_submit_feedback_core consumes beta_anon_consume_ingestion_quota buckets feedback_minute (1/min) and feedback_hour (8/h) for anon callers and beta_feedback_rate_limited for authenticated callers.
Message length (3..4000), category allowlist and forbidden-content filter enforced in the core.
functions.legacyOverload: The 11-argument overload without a token is executable by authenticated only (anon_exec = false) and raises anon_session_required when auth.uid() is null.
functions.residualRisk: Bounded: per-session quotas, but one token holder can still insert up to the quota. Accepted for closed beta.
functions.action: Keep. Advisor WARN is expected and accepted; document as intentional.

functions.name: submit_beta_pedagogy_event
functions.signature: (p_event_type, p_route, p_lesson_id, p_exercise_kind, p_exercise_index, p_metadata, p_local_profile_id, p_client_dedupe_key, p_client_context, p_anon_session_token)
gates: Anonymous callers must present p_anon_session_token (anon_session_required; resolved by beta_anon_resolve_ingestion_session).
Authenticated callers must have profiles.pedagogy_analytics_consent = true (consent_required).

Anonymous quotas: pedagogy_minute 60/min, pedagogy_day 1000/day, plus per-event-type minute/day buckets; authenticated callers use beta_pedagogy_event_rate_limited / beta_pedagogy_event_type_rate_limited.
Event type allowlist, 2 KiB payload cap and sanitize_pedagogy_metadata allowlist.
functions.residualRisk: Telemetry only (no reward, no entitlement). search_path = public (not empty) is acceptable because the function is pinned; hardening to '' is optional and must be diffed against the production definition first.
functions.action: Keep. Advisor WARN is expected and accepted; document as intentional.

authenticatedSecurityDefiner.verified: Live read 2026-10-08: every one of the 28 signatures pins search_path (public or ''), anon cannot execute any of them except the two PUBLIC_INTENTIONAL token overloads above, and all 27 non-admin names bind to auth.uid() (ensure_league_membership and sync_league_week take p_user_id but raise 'not authorized' unless it equals auth.uid()).
authenticatedSecurityDefiner.rule: Signed-in learners are meant to call these RPCs; the WARN only says authenticated can execute a definer function. Classified by group, not revoked. The client's only write path to server economy/league/referral state is these RPCs, so REVOKE would break the product.

decision.freePlan: ACCEPT_ADVISOR_WARN: document as a known, plan-gated limitation; compensating controls are signup/login rate limits (signup_rate_events, login_rate_events), Turnstile on create-account and the minimum password policy.
